scenarios.reasoning: The agent produced a mostly useful analysis but missed a key failing project (FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests) because it only retrieved 20 of 169 errors and failed to recover when its bash attempt to read the full output errored out. The error identification and framework analysis were good, but missing an entire failing project is a significant gap. The approach was somewhat efficient (4 tool calls) but the failure to retry reading the full output or paginate through all results was a missed opportunity.
